trigger.fact: D0039 Q7/Q8/Q9 require an actual strictly-higher D0020 route cutover, while verified D0020 explicitly supports initial immutable binding only and the current Worker maps physical owners by agentId alone.

sdd.reason: The missing capability introduces a single route-current election owner, independent recovery trust root, route-generation physical selection, predecessor retirement/exclusion and successor activation semantics. It is reusable across Q7/Q8/Q9 and was explicitly reserved as a future Class-2 D0020 concern.

decision.electionOwner: exactly one durable AgentRouteElectionAuthority per agentId; it owns current route generation/high-water, recovery verifier, cutover request floor, one live cutover and bounded replay/tombstone summaries only
decision.recoveryAuthority: immutable offline Ed25519 route-recovery root independent from management/release/HMAC/provider/D0040 authority; no in-place recovery-root rotation
decision.successorHost: D0044-created route hosts use deterministic generation-bound rh1.<64hex>; explicit imported legacy generation 1 may retain host key agentId
decision.ingress: elected mode resolves election first, requires authenticated request generation equal current, then resolves exact host key; no missing-election legacy fallback
decision.predecessor: available predecessor enters one-way DRAINING then RETIRED after positive quiescence; unavailable/lost predecessor requires both positive physical quiescence and exact provider exclusion
decision.successor: distinct route owner initialized STANDBY with immutable election attachment; no predecessor handles/state; executable only after exact election activation receipt
decision.electionCommit: single atomic current-generation advance after predecessor exclusion/quiescence and successor standby; old generation never becomes current again; crash may cause availability gap but never rollback/split brain
decision.legacyImport: strict tdev.agent-route-election-import.v1: exact legacy generation-1 binding/host/current-state jointly signed by existing route management authority and recovery root, reconciled route-pending -> election-created -> attachment-sealed before elected routing may enable; no rollback or absence inference
decision.providerLossScope: route-object loss/corruption recoverable only while independent election authority and provider control plane needed for positive exclusion survive; election-authority/whole-provider-account loss remains fail-closed
decision.d0039Consumption: D0044 supplies only the higher-route primitive; D0039 still performs fresh successor D0027 realization and terminal Q7/Q8/Q9 evidence on isolated/canonical lanes as authorized
decision.freshElectionGenesis: strict tdev.agent-route-election-genesis.v1: recovery-root-signed exact generation-1 standby route, accepted only from truly absent zero-high-water election state; emits first activation receipt and is create-once

preservedOwners.d0020PerGeneration: connection/delivery/capacity owner remains one immutable route generation

rejectedAlternatives.reuseExistingTrustPrincipal: management/release compromise is the trigger and HMAC/provider/D0040 belong to different authority domains
rejectedAlternatives.generationAwareHostWithoutElection: would allow multiple physical owners without one durable current-generation fact
rejectedAlternatives.missingElectionMeansLegacy: would recreate authority after partial migration/election loss
rejectedAlternatives.pitrOrSameName: cannot restore semantic authority or safety floors
rejectedAlternatives.d0039R13: independently reusable D0020 cutover semantics must not be hidden in the D0039 realization revision chain

implementationOrder: generation-aware Worker route selector plus separate election DO
explicit legacy import and cutover reconciliation
